sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Interchange is a location in Escape from Tarkov. It is the fifth map that was added to the game.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The South Interchange is a key transport location for the city. This strategic area connects the port and harbor with the industrial outskirts of Tarkov. Located in the center of the interchange is a huge ULTRA shopping mall which was used as the main base of operation for the EMERCOM evacuation.

sections.heading: Features
sections.text:
- Stationary weapons in the form of NSV Utyos 12.7x108 heavy machine guns.
- Be aware of Border Snipers and Minefields!
- A fully linked illumination grid, able to be switched on at the power station.

- Alarms around some stores and a triggerable alarm at the KIBA Arms store. The alarms can be switched off at designated terminals.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- The location was expanded with patch 0.12.4.6254 on March 12, 2020.
- The location was completely reworked and expanded with patch 1.0.0.0.41760 on November 15, 2025.
- The three anchor stores are based off real stores:
  - Idea is based off Ikea.
  - Goshan is based off Auchan.
  - OLI is based off OBI.
- The mall is based off the MEGA group stores which can be found all over Russia.
- The MEGA Parnassus Mall in Poroshkino most closely resembles the one that is portrayed in-game.
